article.headline: Furman’s 21 lead SE Louisiana over Little Rock 83-79
article.description: — Jackson Furman’s 21 points helped Southeastern Louisiana defeat Little Rock 83-79 on Saturday.

article.story: LITTLE ROCK, Ark. -- — Jackson Furman’s 21 points helped Southeastern Louisiana defeat Little Rock 83-79 on Saturday. Furman shot 6 of 11 from the field, including 5 for 9 from 3-point range, and went 4 for 5 from the line for the Lions (1-1). Ashley Sims II scored 18 points, shooting 7 for 8, including 3 for 3 from beyond the arc. Tyler Rolison had 16 points and shot 5 of 11 from the field, including 2 for 3 from 3-point range, and went 4 for 6 from the free-throw line. Bradyn Hubbard led the way for the Trojans (0-2) with 16 points and seven rebounds. Little Rock also got 14 points from Jah’likai King. Jalen Lynn finished with 11 points, four assists and two steals. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
